summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Pedilo (Lo de Juan) MVP. 23 pytest backend tests (100% pass) covering public, auth, admin CRUD, RBAC. Frontend e2e tested via Playwright: full customer ordering flow (menu → drawer → cart → checkout → WhatsApp URL build) all PASS, admin login + 4 tabs + categories CRUD + config save & persistence + product/combo lists all PASS. App is production-ready for first iteration.

minor.issue: Returns 401 (correct) but generic 401 for any non-auth admin call without rate limiting / brute-force lockout. Spec from playbook recommends lockout after 5 fails — not implemented.

Cascades delete to products of that category. Behaviour is intentional per code comment, but it is destructive without confirmation in the API; UI does have confirm() dialog. Document this contract clearly.

issues: Header displays 'Pedilo · Lo de Juan' + slogan + delivery badges as expected. No issues.
Tab id is `tab-config` while the visible label is 'Negocio' — minor naming mismatch (cosmetic, not a bug). All 4 tabs functional.

action_items: (Optional / nice-to-have) Add brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (≥5 wrong attempts → temporary block) per auth playbook.
(Optional) Rename data-testid `tab-config` to `tab-business` to match the visible label and the test plan; not blocking.
(Optional) Surface explicit warning in admin UI that deleting a category cascades into deleting its products (currently only generic confirm).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~580 lines but cohesive (single FastAPI module) — acceptable for MVP; consider splitting routers (auth, public, admin) once it grows past 700 lines.
JWT_SECRET correctly read from env, no hardcoded secrets.
All MongoDB queries explicitly project `{'_id': 0}` — no ObjectId leaking. Good.
Async/await used correctly across all DB calls.

CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] together with allow_credentials=True. Browsers block credentialed requests with wildcard origin. Cookie auth works here only because `allow_origin_regex='.*'` echoes the actual origin back. Functional, but for production tighten allow_origins to explicit frontend URL(s).
Cookie set with secure=true, httponly=true, samesite='none' — correct for cross-origin HTTPS preview.
Pydantic models validate all admin inputs (Create/Update). Good.
Frontend api.js correctly uses `process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL` — no hardcoded URLs.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes — excellent testability.
WhatsApp URL build (Checkout.jsx l66-73) strips non-digits, encodes message, opens wa.me — verified working with phone 5492291570800.
test_credentials: admin@pedilo.com / pedilo123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) — login works, JWT cookie set, Bearer token also returned in body.
seed_data_creation: Sample data already seeded by backend on startup: 4 categories (Pollos, Hamburguesas, Milanesas, Empanadas), 7 products, 1 combo (Combo Familiar). Seeding is idempotent (count check). Admin auto-seeded and password auto-updated if env changes. No additional seed data created during testing — all test fixtures cleaned up after each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_pedilo_api.py is the regression baseline; run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Customer flow uses mobile viewport 390x844; admin uses 1280x1024. Admin tabs need ~2s wait after click for async data fetch (Promise.all on /admin/products + /admin/categories). WhatsApp URL is tested by intercepting window.open in browser. Admin tab id is `tab-config` (not `tab-business`).
rca of the issue: No outstanding bugs to root-cause. Initial admin products/combos showing 0 rows during first run was a Playwright timing issue (clicked tab and immediately queried DOM before async useEffect populated the list). Fixed by adding 2.5s wait — confirmed all admin endpoints return 200 with correct data.
